---
title: "Runtime and Ratings"
---

This page compares whether longer films have higher IMDb ratings. In @fig-runtime-rating, the scatter plot compares each film's runtime with its rating.

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| label: fig-runtime-rating
#| fig-cap: "Relationship between film runtime and IMDb rating"

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb Rating")
plt.title("Runtime vs. IMDb Rating")
plt.show()
```

## Average Rating by Decade

The table below shows average IMDb rating of films released each decade.

```{python}
#| echo: true

films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10
films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)
```
